title: feat(spec): gallery + gantt as first-class blueprint view kinds
body:
## Why

The AI **magic-build** agent could only express `list` / `form` / `kanban` / `calendar` views in a blueprint. Both the lenient `BlueprintViewSchema` **and** the `StrictView` mirror (the structured-output contract the model is validated against) capped `view.type` at those four.

So when a user explicitly asked for a **画廊/gallery** or **甘特图/gantt**, the model literally could not emit it — the closest allowed enum value (`list`) won and the view silently downgraded to a grid. Reproduced live: a build prompt asking for "活动海报的画廊视图" produced `{ viewKind:'list', config:{ type:'grid' } }`, and the agent self-narrated that gallery was "not currently available".

This is **not** a renderer gap: the view spec (`ListViewSchema.type`) already lists `gallery`/`gantt` with `GalleryConfigSchema`/`GanttConfigSchema`, and objectui ships `ObjectGallery` + `plugin-gantt`. The gap was only in the simplified **blueprint proposal** enum.

## What

- Widen `BlueprintViewSchema.type` and the `StrictView` mirror to include `gallery` and `gantt`.
- Enrich the `type` / `columns` / `groupBy` field descriptions with when-to-use guidance (gallery for visual card/cover browse with an image field; gantt for a start+end date timeline; include the image field / order start-before-end in `columns`).
- **No new blueprint slots** — the gallery cover image and the gantt start/end dates are inferred downstream from the object's fields, exactly as kanban's `groupBy` already is. Keeps the strict structured-output schema lean.
- Tests: the lenient schema and the strict mirror both accept `gallery`/`gantt` views.

## Consumer

Paired with **objectstack-ai/cloud** `service-ai-studio`: blueprint `LIST_TYPE` + `viewBody` honor the new kinds (cover/date inference + grid fallback when a gantt lacks two dates), and the build skill/prompt teach when to use them. That cloud PR depends on this one and will bump `.framework-sha` once this merges.

## Test plan

- [x] `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts` — 25 passed (incl. 2 new gallery/gantt cases)
- [x] `view.test.ts` unaffected (201 passed across blueprint+view)
